prompt:
A desktop marketing landing page for White Sail Labs, an independent market research lab, rendered edge to edge at 1440 by 900 with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor is an investor, CEO or strategist deciding whether to request early access. White Sail Labs sells research as a subscription: applied AI engineers and business engineers build an always-on fleet of agents that keeps a living model of every company, and each new fact's surprise ripples through that company's statements and on to its suppliers and customers.

The whole page is one sheet of an accountant's columnar analysis pad. Its ruled column heads carry the navigation: at left a solid sail silhouette with three short speed lines beside the wordmark White Sail Labs, then Who we are, Capabilities, Careers, Contact, and a Request early access button at the far right margin. Across the top rows, set very large: "Your decisions. Better informed." Under it one line, "A research lab of people and agents, not an AI tool.", with Request early access and Get in touch.

The lower half is a live statement, marked Illustrative in the margin. A posting row reads "11 Nov 09:42 · NVIDIA Q3 revenue $57.0B · model expected $54.1B · surprise +$2.9B". The surprise figure is circled in red pencil at billboard size, and red tick marks and arrows carry it down NVIDIA's lines (gross profit, operating income) and across the gutter into the TSMC and Microsoft columns, whose affected figures are updated.

At the bottom edge the next section begins: "Note 1 · Who we are".

Visual law: pale eye-ease green ledger paper ruled in darker green, every word and figure in deep navy ink in one hard-working grotesk with tabular figures, the auditor's red pencil reserved for the surprise alone. One dominant move: the circled surprise and its travelling tick marks.
